newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rio Tinto appoints Cusack Australia MD.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rio Tinto appoints Cusack Australia MD.

text.p: International resources group Rio Tinto Ltd said on Wednesday it had appointed Barry Cusack as Managing Director of Rio Tinto Australia.
Cusack had been with the group for 31 years and was Hamersley Iron managing director of operations before taking this position, Rio Tinto said.

"Barry Cusack's job will be to co-ordinate the common interests of the Australian-based commodity groups and to represent Rio Tinto in Australia, where 38 percent of the Group's assets are located and from which Rio Tinto derives 41 percent of its global sales revenue," Rio Tinto chief executive Leon Davis said in a statement.
"It is imperative this key role be filled by a very senior manager with appropriate line experience and I am very pleased that Barry Cusack is available to take up the position," Davis said.
Cusack's appointment follows the resignation on Tuesday of previous Australian managing director Ian Gould, who was appointed Normandy Mining Ltd Group Managing Director.
